The server reads the customer's Prometheus endpoints that hold worker metrics, such as a collector's exporter, set in FLOWRENSIC_WORKER_SCRAPE_TARGETS (FPP-107-R12).

options.content:
## Worker sends
What the buffer of each worker lost and holds, by env: records it dropped, sends it gave up at their timeout, and records waiting to be sent (FPP-107-R15, R16).

spec.title: Records dropped per second
spec.description: Records a worker dropped from its buffer: past its limit, or in a send that failed or timed out.

spec.title: Sends timed out per second
spec.description: Sends of a worker given up at their timeout.

spec.title: Records waiting to be sent
spec.description: Records waiting in the buffers of the workers of each env, as each worker last reported.

spec.title: Answers 429 per second
spec.description: Reads a Cloud metrics endpoint refused because of its read limit (FPP-106-R08).

spec.title: Cut answers per second
spec.description: Reads where Cloud sent only part of the metrics (FPP-106-R09).
